observed_failure: One startup Invalid sample rate panic; automatic restart recovered. No additional restarts during operator-confirmed continuous and separate-clip playback.

kernel.behavior: Sets speaker_sample_rate from playback hw_params; sets it to zero on speaker close; exposes this value through Speaker Sample Rate.

daemon.behavior: Reads initial rate, then processes IV-sense data. Retains previous nonzero rate when control reads zero; panics if no nonzero rate has been obtained.

newer_releases.2.0.2: J504 speaker-name fix and dependency/logging changes; no sample-rate logic fix.

hypothesis: Startup ordering may permit IV-sense samples while the speaker playback rate remains zero. Source plausibility is not a captured ordering trace or proven root cause.
changes: None to kernel, daemon, safety limits or service ordering. Existing 48 kHz graph workaround retained.
remaining: Capture selected startup ordering evidence and determine which component violates the intended IV-sense/playback contract; do not substitute an assumed rate or weaken protection.
